scope: Development replay of the same frozen forecasts without fitting. Later tool ends are labels only. Selection comparisons re-evaluate recorded old-policy actions; they do not replay allocator decisions, identify all feasible opportunities or prove GPU throughput gains. Rolling timing uses accepted snapshots while exactly one completed tool is active; first triggers are recorded snapshots, not continuous start times. Near-end errors take each tool's median over snapshots with actual remaining <=1000ms before aggregating tools. No actual transmission, Host-only copy, capacity, admission or reuse is implied.

cdf_replay_on_selected_decisions.scope: Subset of recorded decisions, not policy replay or opportunity recall.
